claims.text: The lodge sits on a hilltop with panoramic views.

findings.quote: Perched on a serene hilltop with panoramic views of New Zealand’s most breathtaking landscapes

claims.text: The lodge and its villas sit on a steep hillside 3km west of Queenstown, with uninterrupted views of Lake Wakatipu and the Remarkables mountain range.

findings.quote: Commanding uninterrupted views of this ancient lake and the daunting, snow-swept Remarkables mountain range, the lodge and its 9 villas sit on steep hillside 3kms west of
Lake Wakatipu

claims.text: Downtown Queenstown is five minutes away.

findings.quote: just five minutes away, the vibrant energy of downtown Queenstown

claims.text: Each villa is an identical one-bedroom villa of 79 square metres of open-plan living, with a lounge, dining area and private sun deck.

findings.quote: Each identical luxury one-bedroom villa is 79sqm of open plan living in the midst of the New Zealand natural environment. Incorporating a lounge, dining area, a private sun deck

claims.text: The villas are stand-alone, built of stone and silver beechwood.

findings.quote: Each of the airy, stand-alone, stone and silver beechwood villas is an oasis of luxurious privacy

claims.text: Each villa has individual climate control, including a gas fireplace and under-floor heating.

findings.quote: Individual climate control, including gas fireplace and under-floor heating

claims.text: In-villa massage and mini spa treatments are offered on request.

findings.quote: At Azur we can offer in-villa massage and mini spa treatments upon request.

claims.text: Each villa has a yoga mat, and a private yoga teacher can be arranged on prior request.

findings.quote: Each villa has a yoga mat supplied for you to practice on your own, or alternatively we can recommend local classes or upon prior request arrange for a private teacher to come to you.

claims.text: In-villa dining options are available, and gourmet canapes are served in the lodge.

findings.quote: In-villa dining options
gourmet canapés in the snug comfort of the lodge

claims.text: Azur is close to the Coronet Peak and Remarkables ski fields, the Shotover River, Glenorchy, Arrowtown and the winery areas.

findings.quote: Azur is in close proximity to Queenstown downtown, Coronet Peak & Remarkables ski fields, Shotover River, Glenorchy, Arrowtown and the winery areas.

claims.text: The whole property, villas and main lodge, can be booked for exclusive use.

findings.quote: Azur offers an exclusive, boutique experience with nine luxurious villas and a main lodge, perfect for families, friends, or colleagues seeking privacy and comfort.
Nightly turndown service

claims.text: The bathtub in each villa is set into a bay window with unobstructed views, giving a feeling of being outdoors.

findings.quote: Soak up the spectacular unobstructed views from the bathtub, which has been set into a bay window to give you a feeling of being outdoors.

claims.text: Uninterrupted views of Lake Wakatipu and the Remarkables mountain range from a steep hillside just west of Queenstown.

findings.quote: Commanding uninterrupted views of this ancient lake and the daunting, snow-swept Remarkables mountain range, the lodge and its 9 villas sit on steep hillside 3kms west of
Lake Wakatipu

claims.text: Stand-alone villas built of stone and silver beechwood, each with a private sun deck.

findings.quote: Each of the airy, stand-alone, stone and silver beechwood villas is an oasis of luxurious privacy
a private sun deck

claims.text: Guests can stargaze from their private deck.

findings.quote: simply relax on your private deck and stare into the glittering skies

claims.text: Children under 13 are not permitted at Azur Lodge.

findings.quote: Children under 13 years old are not permitted at Azur Lodge.

claims.text: There is a two-night minimum stay.

findings.quote: Two night minimum

claims.text: There is no gym on site; guests get complimentary access to a local Queenstown gym instead.

findings.quote: Although we do not have a gym on-site all guests receive complimentary access to our local Queenstown Gym.
